result.notes: Ran 40 WebSearch calls: one firm-specific query per seed (two for Devli incl. a devli.com domain sweep and one for Deugen, two for STRO/BLP, one each for the 30 other seeds), plus reconciliation queries (QuadReal/Transwestern 330 S Randolphville Rd, Saddleback/Legacy Real Estate Developers, Heritage Capital identity). Local deals CSV supplied NJ evidence for every seed, so searches went to identity, stated strategy and people. Strongest stated buy boxes found: STRO (value-add and stabilized small-to-medium industrial in Northern NJ; Albert Fitch MD Acquisitions & Capital Markets), Lovett (100,000 SF to 5M SF portfolios, core cash-flowing; Michael Allen East Region), Calare ($10M-$50M middle-market Northeast industrial/flex), Zurich AAM ($15M-$100M, 14 markets, fully leased), Deugen (50K-100K SF infill projects), BLP (value-add/core-plus infill last-mile; Will Gilkeson Investment Officer Northeast in East Rutherford office; Greg Boler MD East), Ambient (core/core-plus/value-add IOS - truck terminals, container yards; Patrick Hackett co-founder; supplements the criteria-less A6 row), MCB (vacant buildings with tenant in tow), Altman (Class A infill logistics land in supply-constrained submarkets, JV with DWS/Renard/DHS). Devli: devli.com/acquisitions lists asset classes only (no SF/price band); Mark Devli CIO, Chris Devli COO; RE-NJ calls the firm Wallington-based; Deugen is a separate Hoboken builder that co-invested with Devli only on 449 Doremus Ave Newark. Reconciled a local-CSV conflict: 330 S Randolphville Rd Piscataway was a Transwestern/QuadReal 2020 development later sold to BlackRock for $80M in 2023. Urban Edge and Colony Industrial are flagged nj_active=no (exited/absorbed); Heritage Capital and Northeast Capital are unknown (net sellers / mixed-use).
